<script src="/assets/triiiceratops-element.iife.js"></script>

<triiiceratops-viewer id="viewer" read-content-state-from-url></triiiceratops-viewer>
<script>
    const viewer = document.getElementById('viewer');
    const { capture, serialize } = window.Triiiceratops.contentState;

    function writeViewToUrl(state) {
        state.subscribeSettled(() => {
            const target = capture(state);
            if (!target) return;
            const url = new URL(location.href);
            url.searchParams.set('iiif-content', serialize(target));
            history.replaceState(history.state, '', url);
        });
    }

    viewer.addEventListener('viewerstateavailable', (event) => {
        writeViewToUrl(event.detail);
    });
    if (viewer.viewerState) writeViewToUrl(viewer.viewerState);
</script>

content.text: Those fixtures were captured from Cookbook recipes on the dates recorded above, and the Cookbook keeps changing. A scheduled advisory job,

, fetches the live recipes weekly and reports where the recipe catalog, the vendored manifests or a fixture's pinned manifest and canvas no longer match what iiif.io publishes. It files a GitHub issue; it never fails a build, and it is never a required check. A maintainer decides what to update.
Run it locally against the live Cookbook:

node scripts/recipe-drift.mjs                        # all 67 cataloged recipes
node scripts/recipe-drift.mjs --recipe 0009-book-1   # spot-check one
